card.name: Words right before "towers" in bird-collision text
card.fires_on: Small linking words and modifiers just before the word tower(s), such as with, of, by, these, the, communications. Seen in web text about communication towers, wind turbines and bird deaths.

modes.label: Linking word before towers
modes.description: A preposition or determiner right before the word towers in a bird-collision passage.
modes.example: these migrating songbirds collide<< with>> towers or the accompanying guy wires.

modes.label: Modifier before tall structures
modes.description: An adjective or noun that leads into a tall structure such as towers or propellers.
